bad-ice-cream-3.title: Bad Ice Cream 3 - Free Online Puzzle Game
bad-ice-cream-3.slogan: Chill out with the coolest arcade game!
bad-ice-cream-3.description: Dive into Bad Ice Cream 3, the ultimate puzzle adventure! Break through icy blocks, outsmart frosty foes, and collect delicious fruits. With vibrant graphics and engaging music, this game offers hours of fun. Play solo or team up in 2-player mode. Ready to scoop up some fun? Play Bad Ice Cream 3 now!

HomeIframe.title: Bad Ice Cream 3
HomeIframe.description: Experience the coolest arcade game! Break ice blocks, collect fruits, and defeat monsters in Bad Ice Cream 3.

HomeFeatures.whatIsDescription: Bad Ice Cream 3 is an exciting action and puzzle game where you play as a brave ice cream, collecting fruits and avoiding monsters.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep1: Choose the game mode by opening one or two boxes of ice cream.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep2: Remember the command keys for precise and flexible operations.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep3: Collect all the fruits in each level and avoid ferocious monsters.
HomeFeatures.feature1Description: Lovely and colorful graphics that give a sense of nostalgia and enjoyment.
HomeFeatures.feature2Description: Fun and engaging music that creates a vibrant and stimulating atmosphere.
HomeFeatures.feature3Description: Rich gameplay with many challenging levels, from easy to difficult.
HomeFeatures.feature4Description: Cooperate and support each other to complete missions with a friend.
